notes.title: Ahro V2.0 The Body & Spirit Update is coming in November!
notes.content:
Marking the 1 Year anniversary of the release of Ahro, we're happy to announce that Ahro V2.0, The Body & Spirit Update is coming in November! It will include:

New breakdown options (for easier gameplay)

New colors options to customize your spirit tail

Bug fixes

Ahro on Linux (via Steam)

Ahro soundtrack for purchase (on Steam)

Ahro Print Edition Lorebook for purchase

Stay tuned for more!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41513101/57d10530d5765828b5a2fe6d1a746b4e6d0a6270.gif"]

notes.title: Ver. 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Ver 1.2 update includes small but useful improvements, including hints that may help players in the third and forth levels.


Updates include: 

Level 2
Added door enter arrow to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added door enter arrow (and purple glow) to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added new "zoom to hint targets" hint sign and functionality

Level 3 & 4
Decreased herb regen cooldown time in a few places (so herbs reappear sooner)

Level 4
Added hint arrow number indicators that help players know in which order they should attempt to fly to destinations

Plus small bug fixes
